note: Tier 2, the attach question (303.4f). A casts Rescue Skiff, an artifact Spacecraft that is not a creature until it has 10 or more charge counters (721.2b), so it has no power or toughness on the stack (721.2c) or on the battlefield (208.3). Its enters trigger returns Rancor from A's graveyard to the battlefield; the effect does not say what the Aura enchants, so A chooses as it enters (303.4f) and attaches it to A's Grizzly Bears, which become 4/2 with trample (613.1, 613.4c). The position is stipulated (spec 2.4), not reached by ordinary play.
